item.title: Golden Era of Flops
item.description: While 2XKO was/is an embarrassing failure, let's not forget about the other embarrassing failure in Fighting Games the past 15 years, that being Fatal Fury City of The Wolves. It's truly the most embarrassing bomb of a Fighting Game, and torpedoed SNK's already in the ground reputation even further than thought possible. It has 5 guests characters including 2 legendary Street Fighter characters, an iconic classic shounen anime protagonist, and one of the most popular Football play
